g.text: Who supplies the parts: market share
HBM is a three-company market. Accelerators are mostly NVIDIA, with custom chips growing.
SK hynix had 64% a year earlier. Samsung jumped from 21% in Q1 by shipping HBM4 first. Figures round to 101%.
Data-center AI accelerator revenue share · 2026 analyst estimates (they vary)
Custom chips = Google TPU (~6–8%), AWS Trainium (~2–3%), Microsoft Maia, Meta MTIA. NVIDIA was ~92% in 2023.
Why this matters for a Claude roadmap
Every accelerator needs HBM, so HBM supply caps how fast anyone can add serving capacity.
Anthropic runs on all three accelerator families, which hedges against any one supplier running short.
